guessed: S1/S2: the hub wall is only 10 thick (22.5 - 12.5), so a 12 deep Ø5 hole from the hub surface breaks into the Ø25 bore; that is the drawing's geometry (set-screw holes), not a code error.

K: 57.5 read as the pocket's centre line, so the 8 x 7 pocket spans y 54..61 (16 from the axis), matching the keyway top drawn above the bore circle; a pocket ending at 57.5 would remove no material at all.
